appDescription: An in-car rest app that adjusts the seat, climate and lighting while parked or charging and wakes the user when the session ends.

function.name: START_REST_MODE
function.description: Start a rest session in the parked vehicle with the requested rest type and duration.

restType.description: Type of rest session to start.

durationMinutes.description: Length of the rest session in minutes.

function.name: END_REST_MODE
function.description: End the current rest session and restore the seat and climate settings saved before it started.

function.name: GET_REST_STATUS
function.description: Report the remaining time of the current rest session and the current battery charge level.
